samosbor.event.warning: §eWARNING! Signs of Samosbor detected on the floor. Drop your work and head for blast doors!
samosbor.event.escalation: §c§lALARM! SAMOSBOR! IMMEDIATELY CLOSE AND SEAL BLAST DOORS!
samosbor.event.peak: §4§lSAMOSBOR PEAK! DO NOT ENTER THE CORRIDOR! DO NOT OPEN THE DOOR UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES!
samosbor.event.recession: §aALL CLEAR. Samosbor has receded. Wait for Liquidator purge teams.
samosbor.door.sealed: §eBlast door is sealed with valve lock.
advancements.samosbor.root.title: Welcome to Gigakhrushch
advancements.samosbor.root.description: Awaken within the endless concrete corridors of the cyclopean residential megastructure.
advancements.samosbor.seal_door.title: Valve Tightened
advancements.samosbor.seal_door.descript: Airtight seal a blast door with its rotating valve
advancements.samosbor.weld_door.title: Dead-Weld
advancements.samosbor.weld_door.descript: Weld a blast door shut with the RG-3 gas cutter
advancements.samosbor.survive_samosbor.d: Survive the peak of Samosbor inside a sealed room
advancements.samosbor.filter_replaced.de: Replace a GP-5K filter box in a hazardous environment
advancements.samosbor.cook_borscht.title: Blue Flame
advancements.samosbor.cook_borscht.descr: Ignite the burner of a Lysva kitchen stove and cook up a steaming bowl of hot, hearty borscht.
advancements.samosbor.cult_altar.title: Heretical Altar
advancements.samosbor.cult_altar.descrip: Discover a Biomass Cult shrine deep in the corridors
advancements.samosbor.slay_valera.title: Relic of the Breach
advancements.samosbor.slay_valera.descri: Defeat the Apex Mimic monstrosity born of the chthonic breach
advancements.samosbor.seal_hermetic_door: Lock a blast door with the manual rotating valve, preparing your living cell for lockdown.
advancements.samosbor.weld_hermetic_door: Permanently weld the blast door seams using an RG-3 gas cutter. Nothing can get through now.
advancements.samosbor.survive_siren.desc: Wait out the apocalyptic howling siren inside an airtight room through the peak Samosbor cycle until all clear.
advancements.samosbor.replace_filter.des: Swap an exhausted GP-5K filter canister onto your gas mask amidst toxic atmospheric danger.
advancements.samosbor.drink_moonshine.de: Down a flagon of pungent bootleg hooch fermented from floor spores and concrete mold.
advancements.samosbor.repair_blue_tape.d: Patch broken tools or torn protective gear with a few wraps of legendary GOST blue tape.
advancements.samosbor.garbage_chute_find: Drop unwanted junk down the cast-iron chute and salvage a lost ration ticket from the hatch.
advancements.samosbor.number_station.des: Tune a radio receiver into the classified UVB-76 frequency or listen to a lost MK-60 cassette tape.
advancements.samosbor.listen_walls.title: Listen to the Walls
advancements.samosbor.listen_walls.descr: Press the ST-4 stethoscope to the concrete wall and detect the pulsing crawl of biomass behind it.
advancements.samosbor.party_dossier.desc: Read through classified Party Dossier records detailing sealed floors and the horrifying reality of the Gigakhrushch.
advancements.samosbor.radiation_check.de: Hold a DP-5V dosimeter in hand and listen to the frantic chatter of the Geiger counter near biohazard zones.
advancements.samosbor.cleanse_biomass.de: Arm yourself with a Liquidator flamethrower and turn writhing biomass clusters into heaps of ash.
advancements.samosbor.cult_shrine.title: Heretical Altar
advancements.samosbor.cult_shrine.descri: Stumble upon a secluded Biomass Cult shrine hidden deep inside the utility crawlways, draped in crimson nylium.
advancements.samosbor.defeat_valera.desc: Vanquish the Apex Mimic of the Deep Foundations — the ancient abomination that consumed liquidator purge squads during the breach.
